title: DojoLiq Sour Watermelon Candy 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Vaporesso DojoLiq Sour Watermelon Candy delivers a thrilling sweet-and-sour experience. The vape begins with the lush, refreshing sweetness of juicy Watermelon, providing a deeply fruity base. As the flavour settles, a bold sour candy twist takes over on the exhale, cutting through the sweetness with a mouth-watering tang that leaves a lingering, vibrant finish. This Nicotine Salt e-liquid is mixed to an exact 45% VG / 55% PG ratio, a bespoke split chosen to maximise the specific flavour saturation and wicking speed for this recipe. The result is a crystal-clear taste profile suitable for any MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vape kit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it offers a smooth draw and efficient nicotine delivery. Brought to you by the hardware specialists at Vaporesso, the DojoLiq collection captures the vibrant, authentic flavours of their popular Dojo series in a versatile 10ml format. These e-liquids offer rapid nicotine satisfaction and consistently bold taste from the first drop to the last.
